name: Viktor Fedorovych Yanukovych

reason: Person subject to criminal proceedings by the Ukrainian authorities for the misappropriation of public funds or assets.; The criminal proceedings relating to the misappropriation of public funds or assets are still ongoing. The Council therefore considers that the circumstances described in the decision of the High Anti-Corruption Court attributed to Mr Yanukovych have significantly contributed to the length of the investigation.
